extra.final_summary: The data had several issues affecting the analysis: (1) 'species' column had a space variant (' Adelie') and a misspelling ('Chinstarp'), which were corrected using normalize_labels; (2) one exact duplicate row was removed; (3) three rows with negative flipper_length_mm values (below minimum 170) were excluded; (4) one row with an extreme body_mass_g value (3,500,000 g) was excluded. After fixes, the average bill length for Adelie penguins by island is: Biscoe: 38.375 mm, Dream: 39.386 mm, Torgersen: 38.125 mm. The sex column has one missing value, but it was not fixed as per rules (do not guess).
